pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (Modal) and Alert Dialog patterns, implemented with native <dialog>.showModal().

keyboard.action: Moves focus among dialog controls; background is inert (native modal).
Emits cancelable aui-cancel, then closes and restores focus.
No effect; the native close request is prevented.

focus: On open, focus moves to the autofocus action or first focusable element. On close, focus returns to the element focused before opening.
notes: Background inertness and top-layer rendering are provided by the browser.
Scroll lock uses scrollbar-gutter to avoid layout shift.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
